visible_text: Windows は次の周で追います。
決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
オンボーディングを試作する

answers.q1: They look grounded rather than invented: each 'メモ' item is tagged with a person's name (Ken, Sarah), a timestamp, and a small '出所' (source) link, and the same lines also appear verbatim in the right-hand transcript with matching times. That pattern reads as 'pulled from what was said,' not an AI guess — though nothing on screen literally states a confidence or origin label, so it's an inference from the attribution pattern rather than an explicit statement.
answers.q2: I would click the '出所' (source) link directly under the memo line I want to check, e.g. under 'macOS を先に出します'.
answers.q3: Yes — each memo line shows 'Name・time' right underneath it (e.g. 'Ken・10:42', 'Sarah・14:21'), and the transcript panel on the right repeats the same name+timestamp+text, so who/when is doubly confirmed.
answers.q4: Unclear. There is a small chevron (˅) to the right of each memo item, which might expand to an edit option, but there's no visible pencil/edit/delete icon or 'correct this' affordance. I'd guess I have to click the chevron and hope, or open '出所' and edit from the transcript, but neither is confirmed by the UI.
answers.q5: Moderately uneasy. The per-item source links build some confidence, but the '決まったこと' (Decisions) and 'やること' (Action items) sections both say they're still waiting for content, so the meeting summary looks incomplete/in-progress. Sharing it now risks handing someone a half-finished doc, and since I can't find a clear correction path, I can't be sure a wrong item would be easy to fix before sharing.

weaknesses.what: No visible edit/correct affordance on memo items — only an ambiguous chevron with unclear function (expand? edit? collapse detail?).
weaknesses.fix: Add an explicit pencil/edit icon or a small 'correct' action next to each memo item so users know exactly where to fix a wrong extraction.

weaknesses.what: '決まったこと' and 'やること' both show placeholder 'waiting' text, making the summary look incomplete at first glance.
weaknesses.fix: Either hide empty sections until populated, or show a lighter-weight 'in progress' indicator that doesn't read as a stalled/broken feature.

weaknesses.what: Groundedness is implied only by the presence of name+timestamp+出所, with no explicit label like 'from transcript' vs 'AI inference', so a literal-minded first-time user could still wonder if the summary text was paraphrased/altered by the AI.
weaknesses.fix: Add a one-word tag (e.g. '引用' vs '要約') distinguishing verbatim quotes from AI-paraphrased extractions.
